newsitem.title: USA: Natural Health acquires Global Health.
newsitem.headline: Natural Health acquires Global Health.

text.p: Natural Health Trends Corp said Thursday it had entered a pact to acquire Global Health Alternatives Inc, a closely held Delaware corporation that markets and distributes natural health care products.

Natural Health said the deal would be accomplished by exchanging 5.8 million shares of common stock and said additional shares would be issuable after the acquisition based on Global's future earnings.
Natural Health shares were up 3/32 Thursday at 7/8.

Natural said once the acquisition is completed, Global Health Chairman Brian Wolfson would become chairman and a director of Natural Health Trends Corp, and that Global's chief financial officer, Robert Bruce, would become chief financial officer and vice president of finance at Natural Health.
Additionally, Global's co-chief operating officers, John Eldredge and Joseph Grace, would join Natural Health as vice presidents and manage Global's operations from Global's Portland, Maine offices.

"The acquisition of Global Health Alternatives marks a critical turning point in the development of Natural Health Trends Corp," said Natural Health President and Chief Executive Neal Heller in a company statement. "We are responding to overwhelming consumer demand for alternative health care services and products."
The company said the deal should be completed in July.
